Low-E Glass Windows Low-E (Low Emissivity) glass features an ultra-thin metallic coating that reflects infrared heat while allowing natural light to pass through — significantly reducing heat transfer in both summer and winter for West Valley City homeowners. When paired with argon gas fills and insulated vinyl or fiberglass frames, Low-E glass windows deliver measurably lower U-factor ratings and can reduce heating and cooling costs by up to 30% compared to standard single-pane windows. Triple Pane Windows Triple-pane windows feature three layers of glass with two insulating gas-filled chambers, offering the highest level of thermal resistance available in residential window replacement today. Increasingly popular among West Valley City and Murray, UT homeowners seeking maximum energy savings, triple-pane units deliver the lowest U-factor ratings on the market — ideal for north-facing rooms, basement egress windows, or any space where heat loss and sound insulation are top priorities.
